43576.title: Global search returns navigational results only and does not modify the current table
43576.custom_preconds: You are signed in and able to visit the Work Orders list, Parts > Inventory, and a Customer detail Notes tab.

custom_steps_separated.content: On the Work Orders list (/workorders), type a query into the global header search.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Global search returns navigational results only; the Work Orders table does not change.
The Inventory table does not change.

custom_steps_separated.content: Repeat on a Customer detail Notes tab (/customers/:id/notes).
custom_steps_separated.expected: The notes table does not change.

43577.title: Global search no longer alters the record set on any surface (app-wide sweep)
43577.custom_preconds: You have access to representative surfaces across Work Orders, Customers, Parts, Administration, Reports and Dashboard, including detail-page tables and the audit-log dialog.

custom_steps_separated.content: On a representative surface from each area, type a query into the global header search.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The visible record set is unchanged on every surface, including detail-page tables and the audit-log dialog. Treat this as an app-wide sweep rather than a per-module check.

43578.title: Page-filtering code path is removed and stale URL / persisted terms no longer filter
43578.custom_preconds: You have a URL or saved state that previously carried a global search term into page-level filtering.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open a page using a URL or state that previously applied a global search term as a page filter.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The page loads with no global-search-driven filtering applied; such params/state no longer affect the table.

custom_steps_separated.content: Try to make global search filter the current page through any prior entry point (typing, URL param, persisted value).
custom_steps_separated.expected: There is no way to make global search filter the page. The old behaviour is absent, not merely hidden behind a flag.

43579.title: Every affected surface still offers text narrowing via page search
43579.custom_preconds: You are checking the affected surfaces listed in the PRD. Locate each by URL, as seven are named differently in code than in the UI.

custom_steps_separated.content: Visit each affected surface and look for a search control.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Every affected surface still offers text narrowing through the shared table component's page-search control; no surface loses the ability to search.

43580.title: Global-search filtering is not removed from a page before page search is available there
43580.custom_preconds: The rollout is phased, so some pages may not yet have page search (Story 13).

custom_steps_separated.content: Identify a page where page search is not yet available, and use the global header search on it.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Global-search page filtering has not been removed from that page yet, so the page still has a way to narrow by text. Removal only happens once page search is live on that page.
